notes: Targeted Standard/normal mesh sweeps; not the A/B/C/D qualification rerun.
Each case uses its selected method: the three bundled examples use Picard; the archived fixture requests Newton.
All grids cover 360 electrical degrees at 7.5 degree steps (48 loaded and 48 no-load positions).
Exploratory baseline and baseline-tight runs partly overlapped; compare reported-before with fixed for solve-time changes.
Timings are single backend solve passes, including meshing and result packaging, with field-cache persistence disabled.
The initial baseline SPM used Python 3.11.0b4; every other run, including both performance comparison passes, used Python 3.12.14.
Iteration summaries exclude congruence-reused positions; their source evidence remains in the per-position arrays.
Newton residual definitions differ before and after; compare them using their recorded definitions and tolerances.
